content: Dapagliflozin has been shown to be effective in reducing the risk of hospitalization due to heart failure in patients with both preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), as demonstrated in the DELIVER trial. Furthermore, the use of dapagliflozin led to improvements in functional capacity and alleviation of symptoms, establishing it as a valuable therapeutic option for managing various types of heart failure.
